text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text:
At a festive venue such as this, the hearts of the people naturally grow lively.
To create a dish that delights all—young and old alike…
That is indeed a vexing challenge.
text_block_list.orig_text:
斯くの如き祝祭の場、
民草の心も華やぐと云ふもの。
足を運ぶ老若男女、
皆々が喜ぶ料理となると……
此れは中々に悩ましき難事なりけり。

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text:
Since stirring the hearts of all is exceedingly difficult,
we shall first craft a dish to delight the innocent children.
With the Knight’s help, it shall surely turn out delicious.
text_block_list.orig_text:
万人の心躍らせるは
至難の極み故。
先ずは愛らしき稚児らの為、
童心くすぐる一品を。
騎士殿の御手を借りられるとあらば、
美味なる品と仕上がりましょうぞ。
